text:
### Bank-Initiated Closure (Special Process)  
**Characteristics:**
- Bank initiates closure (regulatory, fraud, policy)
- May be urgent or emergency scenario
- Account may be frozen  
**Actions:**
- Document closure reason in system
- Compliance/manager approval required
- Legal review (if significant financial impact)
- Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)
- Investigation documentation attached  
**Timeline:** Immediate (freeze) + 7–30 days (notice period)

raw_entities.name: Bank-Initiated Account Closure
raw_entities.description: A bank-initiated account closure process triggered by regulatory requirements, fraud detection, or policy violations. The process may involve immediate account freezing followed by a mandatory customer notice period of 7–30 days, with compliance and management approval required throughout.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)

raw_entities.name: Document Closure Reason in System
raw_entities.description: The initial step in which the bank records the specific reason for the account closure in the system, establishing the audit trail and compliance record for the closure decision.

raw_entities.name: Compliance and Manager Approval
raw_entities.description: A mandatory approval gate requiring sign-off from both compliance staff and management before the account closure can proceed, ensuring regulatory and policy compliance.

raw_entities.name: Legal Review
raw_entities.description: A conditional legal review step triggered when the account closure has significant financial impact, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation before closure is finalized.

raw_entities.name: Customer Notice
raw_entities.description: Formal notification to the customer of the account closure decision, with a standard notice period of 30 days or immediate notice in emergency scenarios.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)

raw_entities.name: Investigation Documentation Attachment
raw_entities.description: The step of attaching investigation documentation and supporting evidence to the closure record in the system, creating a complete audit trail for the closure decision.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: The compliance team responsible for approving bank-initiated account closures and ensuring regulatory requirements are met throughout the closure process.

raw_entities.name: Manager
raw_entities.description: The manager responsible for approving the bank-initiated account closure decision alongside compliance staff, ensuring management oversight of the closure.

raw_entities.name: Legal Team
raw_entities.description: The legal team responsible for reviewing account closures with significant financial impact to ensure legal compliance and mitigate risk.

raw_entities.name: Significant Financial Impact Assessment
raw_entities.description: A decision gate determining whether the account closure has significant financial impact, which triggers escalation to legal review if true.

raw_entities.name: Emergency Closure Scenario Assessment
raw_entities.description: A decision gate determining whether the closure is an emergency scenario, which shortens the customer notice period from 30 days to immediate notification.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance checkpoint ensuring that bank-initiated closures triggered by regulatory requirements are properly documented and approved before proceeding.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance checkpoint verifying that fraud-related account closures are properly investigated and documented before customer notification.

raw_entities.name: Account Subject to Bank-Initiated Closure
raw_entities.description: The customer account being closed by the bank due to regulatory, fraud, or policy reasons, which may be frozen during the closure process.
